# NOTES-R2 measures: Julien's notes on the R2 reel (2026-11-19 to 2026-11-22)

Fresh checkout: the soundfont (bank C, sha256 f9a37b36...) was fetched, and one full build on the unchanged code reproduced `assets/audio` byte for byte (33,249,842 B), so the "before" numbers below come from that build's `report.json`. Loops were not touched, so no loop audit was re-run.

## The table

| # | His words | Cues | What I changed | Measured result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "I am going to need to hear the entire score when you are finished please. Sample at a bitrate that is higher than the one used for the recent reel. Raise the cap on file size limit to 32MB" (2026-11-19) | every cue | Nothing new: already done in card M2c (`KBPS = 256` in `build.py`, `src/audio/__tests__/logic.test.ts` caps the total at 32 * 1024 * 1024, full-score reel built). Checked, not rebuilt. | `KBPS` 256 then (192 since row 5); total 33,015,520 B then, 27,787,604 B now. The card's check line still says 14,680,064; Julien's 32 MB replaces it. |
| 2 | "Encode at 256kbps and increase the bit depth where possible while staying within the size limit" (2026-11-19) | every cue | Nothing new: already done in card M2c. AAC has no bit depth; the encoder is fed 32-bit float (`post.encode`, `float_in=True`) and the 32-bit float WAV masters are kept in `build/master`. SFX stay 16-bit in at 64 kbps because they did not change. | Same total as row 1. Stingers measure 94 to 168 kbps (little above 7 kHz to code), loops and story at the requested 256. |
| 3 | "No the stingers and story moments do not sit well over the music" (2026-11-22) | the 12 stinger kinds that play over a ducked loop (all six neighbourhoods) and `victor_exit` | He named no cue and no direction. I measured the three differences that I can: brightness (median share of energy above 5 kHz: loops 0.29%, stingers 0.05%, story 0.09%, so the stingers are darker than the loops, not brighter, and I left the 7 kHz and 10 kHz roll-offs alone), key and bar (already aligned to chord I by the director) and level (the stinger sat +3 to +13 LU above the ducked loop). I changed the level only: `STING_LUFS` in `build.py` down 2 to 3.5 LU (bottleneck and offline included), `victor_exit` -16 to -19. Kept: perk at -20 (layered over exclusive cues, where the loop is silent), triumphs, city theme, rep stings, recipe and reunion (exclusive: the loop is off). The ladder keeps D5's order with 1 LU between rungs, because a first try with manager = build failed the build's momentary-max check by up to 0.8 LU. | Mean LUFS over the six neighbourhoods, before to after, then the cue over its ducked loop (loop -20, minus the director's duck): bottleneck -22.0 to -24.0 (+1.0 to -1.0 LU), upgrade, fleet, drone -20.0 to -23.0 (+6.0 to +3.0), milestone -19.1 to -22.0 (+6.9 to +4.0), welcome -19.0 to -22.0 (+9.0 to +6.0), warmth -20.0 to -23.0 (+8.0 to +5.0), manager -17.2 to -19.5 (+11.8 to +9.5), build -17.3 to -20.5 (+11.7 to +8.5), milestone_big -16.6 to -18.6 (+12.4 to +10.4), offline -22.0 to -25.0 (+6.0 to +3.0), bid -18.1 to -21.0, victor_exit -16.0 to -19.0, perk unchanged. Hierarchy check (manager, build, milestone, upgrade, bottleneck, integrated and momentary max) passes in all six neighbourhoods. |

| 6 | "Notes for a3 - only the downtown stinger lands wrong" (2026-11-22) | `sting/downtown_*` (11 kinds; the perk is unchanged); every other neighbourhood's stingers and `victor_exit` go back to what he heard | This answers row 3's "say which cue": the cue is the Downtown stinger and the others are fine. 1) Round 1's 2 to 3.5 LU cut on the other five neighbourhoods, `bid` and `victor_exit` was a guess he has now cleared, so those tiers are restored (`build.STING_LUFS` is the old ladder, `victor_exit` -16). 2) Downtown gets its own ladder (`build.STING_LUFS_HOOD`): the round-1 ladder with a further 2 LU, because the one thing about the level that is Downtown's alone is its first bed, `downtown_sparse`, at -22 LUFS (every other loop is -20), so on the same tier a Downtown stinger sat 2 LU higher over it than any other stinger sits over its loop. 3) `reel.py stinger_run` placed every stinger on the first bar line; it now takes the next tonic bar within 2 bars and 2.5 s as the director does (AU47, AU63, AU74), the bottleneck on the next beat (a dotted quarter in 6/8), and ducks the loop 6 dB further when no tonic bar is in reach. "Lands wrong" gave no direction, and I cannot hear, so 2 and 3 are my reading, not a fix to a cause I found. | Downtown LUFS by kind, before (round 1) to after: bottleneck -24 to -26, offline -25 to -27, milestone and welcome -22 to -24, upgrade, fleet, drone and warmth -23 to -25, manager -19.5 to -21.5, build -20.5 to -22.5, milestone_big -18.5 to -20.5, perk -20 unchanged; measured on the build: -26.0, -27.0, -24.0, -24.0, -25.0 x4, -21.5, -22.5, -20.5, -20.0. Hierarchy check (milestone_big > manager >= build > milestone > upgrade > bottleneck, integrated and momentary max) passes in all six neighbourhoods. Other neighbourhoods measure on their old tiers again (suburbs milestone -19.1, industrial manager -17.3, waterfront bid -18.1, `victor_exit` -16.0). Reel: Downtown run in `R2.txt` now has bottleneck bar 4, upgrade bar 7, milestone bar 10 (all tonic), manager bar 15 (no tonic bar in reach, loop -15 dB) and milestone_big bar 20 (tonic); Industrial moved to bars 2, 4, 7, 10 and 13. What I checked and ruled out as Downtown-only: the loop's bar phase against its bar grid (bass onsets sit on the grid in Downtown as in the others), the stinger's first onset against `downbeatSeconds` (scatter of 5 to 120 ms in every neighbourhood), tonic landing odds (Downtown 43%, the others 25 to 50%) and the share of held stinger notes that sit a semitone or a ninth from the loop's chord (Downtown 15 to 24%, the others 7 to 46%). |
